thread:
sara-cs: Customer reports invoice shows ~12k embedding units but dashboard only 3k. They're escalated and asking for a breakdown.

mike-ml: Got it. Any sample request or customer request_id? Could be retries, rerank, or fallback to a different model.

sara-cs: Customer id: cus_82ef. Example SDK payload they sent (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  \"model\": \"rwd-embed-2-small\",
  \"inputs\": [\"short one\", \"a very long text ... (truncated)\", \"\"],
  \"truncate\": true
}
```

mike-ml: Two quick suspects: 1) retries counted multiple times in billing export, 2) rerank/pairwise calls multiply billable units. Do they call /v1/rerank anywhere?

sara-cs: Customer says they only call embeddings directly but they use a proxy/third-party service that does some post-processing. SDK logs from their side show both endpoints called around the same times.

ben-oncall: Can you paste the service logs for the inbound requests (server side) around those timestamps? We need to see request_id, attempt numbers and final status.

sara-cs: Server logs (sanitized):
```
2026-02-24T12:02:58Z request_id=req_aa attempt=1 status=500 route=/v1/embeddings
2026-02-24T12:02:59Z request_id=req_aa attempt=2 status=502 route=/v1/embeddings
2026-02-24T12:03:02Z request_id=req_aa attempt=3 status=200 route=/v1/embeddings vectors_returned=3
```

tasha-billing: Billing pipeline historically aggregates by final successful event, but the export job that feeds invoicing accidentally included all attempts for a specific time range last run (bug introduced in export v1.4.0). That could create duplication. We also had a rerank pairwise billing multiplier change earlier this quarter — check if they hit the old path.

mike-ml: Another note: very long inputs get internally split for memory reasons. In an early path we would index/truncate the long input and emit both a prefix vector and a suffix vector (two vectors per original input). If that split happens AND retries occurred, you can easily get a 4x or more inflation. I reproduced locally: send 10 inputs with one >64k chars -> billing events show 13 vectors billed.

sara-cs: Repro curl they ran (approx):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2-small","inputs":["a","'$(python3 - <<'PY'\nprint('x'*70000)\nPY
)'"] }'
```

ben-oncall: TL;DR possibilities: retries counted + input splitting + pairwise rerank = big multiplier. We need to determine which of those hit cus_82.

tasha-billing: I will run a reconciliation query now: select invoice_events where customer_id='cus_82ef' and created_at between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-08'. I'll check for duplicate request_id values and for rerank line items.

mike-ml: Actionable repro steps I used to confirm split behavior:
1) create a tenant on staging
2) call embeddings with one input >64k chars and two short inputs
3) observe internal split logs (split_count=1) and billing_events emitted: one per produced vector
4) simulate transient 500 errors to trigger retries and observe duplicate billing_events for attempts prior to dedupe fix

mike-ml: minimal repro (safe):
```bash
# simulate long input
python3 -c \"print('x'*70000)\" > long.txt
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H \"Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY\" -d \"{\\\"model\\\":\\\"rwd-embed-2-small\\\",\\\"inputs\\\": [\\\"a\\\", \\\"$(cat long.txt | sed 's/\\\\/\\\\\\\\/g')\\\"]}\"
```

tasha-billing: Preliminary results: invoice_events shows ~12,014 embed events for cus_82 between dates. Of those, 8,987 have unique request_id values; ~3,027 share request_id req_aa pattern (retries) and match the timestamps sara pasted. Looks like retries were exported without dedupe.

sara-cs: Customer sent SDK logs with client-side retries too. They used a wrapper that retries on 502 up to 3x. So both client and server retries in the window.

ben-oncall: Immediate mitigation: I will ask billing to hold invoice generation for cus_82 and revert export to last-good version while we patch the export dedupe.

mike-ml: I'll open a PR to change the emission path: ensure billing_events include attempt_parent_id and ensure export dedupes by attempt_parent_id. I'll also add a metric for split_count so we can alert if many inputs are being split.

tasha-billing: I've paused the invoice and created a ticket BILL-4567. I'll re-run reconciliation once we have the patched export. For now I estimate overbill of ~3k-9k vectors depending on dedupe.

sara-cs: I've told customer we're investigating and will share estimate. They asked for refund if confirmed.

metrics-bot: NOTE: rerank pairwise billing multiplier fix deployed 2026-02-28 in release 2.1.3 — but customers that hit older endpoints before that date may see pairwise charges.

mike-ml: Postmortem actions:
- PR to dedupe billing export (mike)
- add split_count metric and alert (mike/eng-runtime)
- billing reconcile + possible refund (tasha)
- customer SDK guidance: avoid double client retries when using proxies (sara)

sara-cs: Thanks team — I'll update once customer logs arrive.
